operations.used_for: exchange a username and password for the session identifier that authenticates every later call; called once for the retiring secret and once for the incoming one
confirm the incoming session belongs to the account being rotated before the retiring session is retired
terminate a session token; the retiring one is terminated only once its in-flight work has drained
the unit of work bound to a session; an RFC 8693 token exchange whose request body is the form-encoded IssueSpec
